description: Declaragent WhatsApp — 24h conversation-window lifecycle + template-send health. TODO(slice-14): the panels below reference metric names that the WhatsApp adapter (packages/channel-whatsapp) is expected to emit via `channelDeps.metrics` from its conversation-window tracker. The tracker itself is not implemented yet: the adapter currently tracks window state in-memory in `conversation-window.ts` but does not emit metrics. Wiring the tracker to `channel.conversation_window.active` (gauge), `channel.conversation_window.expired_total` (counter), and `channel.template.sent_total` (counter, labelled by `name` + `status`) is a follow-up task tracked against the WhatsApp adapter. Once those emissions land, this dashboard renders without changes.

panels.title: Active conversation windows
panels.description: Count of currently-open 24h sessions (inbound message was received within the last 24h, so free-form replies are allowed without a template).

panels.title: Windows expired (1h)
panels.description: Number of conversation windows that ticked past the 24h mark in the last hour. High churn with low active count means conversations are short.

panels.title: Template sends (1m)
panels.description: Templates per second currently being accepted. A sustained zero rate when the window-active count is also zero usually points at a template-approval problem.

panels.title: Template rejects (1m)
panels.description: Templates per second the WhatsApp Cloud API rejected (unapproved name, wrong parameter count, rate-limit, etc.). Alert when > 0.

panels.title: Active conversation windows over time
panels.description: Gauge: open 24h sessions. Step changes correspond to inbound messages opening a new window or the tracker expiring a stale one.

panels.title: Window expiries (per channel)
panels.description: Per-channel rate of windows aging out past 24h. Paired with the gauge above it tells you how many new windows the channel is opening per hour.

panels.title: Template send rate by name
panels.description: Per-template throughput. Useful for catching an a/b mis-configuration where one template name is sending 0.

panels.title: Template send by status
panels.description: accepted / rejected / error stacked — the decomposition of the rejects stat above.
